abide_fMRI_cohort.dataset_name: ABIDE-I (Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I)

EEG_cohort.dataset_name: KAU ASD EEG Dataset (Djemal et al., 2017, doi:10.3390/app7020183)
EEG_cohort.description: Real King Abdulaziz University EEG dataset: 16 recordings (8 ASD, 8 TD children), 16 channels, 256 Hz. Raw files require data-sharing request to KAU.
EEG_cohort.channel_system: Standard 10-20 (FP1, F3, F7, FP2, F4, F8, T7, P7, T8, P8, C3, Cz, C4, P3, Pz, P4)

cohort_overlap_analysis.details: fMRI (ABIDE-I) and EEG (KAU Djemal2017) cohorts are entirely separate clinical populations with no subject overlap — unaligned multimodal setup.
